label: Hair texture
description: Scalp hair curl patterns, density and surface texture, independent of length or hairstyle.
notes: Curl pattern, density and frizz belong here, phrased as adjectives before hair. person.hair_length owns length; person.hairstyle owns named cuts, arrangements and set curls or waves. Pattern tags and the texture context rule follow person.hair_length_texture, so descent weights patterns without excluding them. Density and frizz carry unspecified texture; sparse and thinning retain the existing life_stage drop treatment.

values.look: strands fall without visible bends or curls
loose S-shaped bends along the strands
very tight bends and tiny zigzag coils with a compact outline
dense, full hair with little scalp showing between strands
delicate, thin individual strands that fall lightly
reduced coverage with scalp showing through the crown or part
widely separated strands with broad areas of visible scalp
a fuzzy halo of lifted strands around the main hair shape
